idea-plugin.name: Resin (Community)
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates the Resin application server into IntelliJ IDEA so you can configure, deploy, run and debug Java web applications without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Add a Resin installation under Settings | Application Servers
  • Create local or remote Resin run configurations
  • Deploy and undeploy web application artifacts
  • Start, stop and monitor the Resin server from the IDE
  • Debug Java and JSP code (including remote debugging over JMX)
  • Automatic detection of Resin 2.x / 3.x / 4.x / 5.x installations

Compatibility
IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 2023.1 (build 232) through 2026.x (build 263). The plugin relies on the bundled Jakarta EE / Application Servers modules, so IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate is required.

This is a community port. The original JetBrains plugin stopped at IDEA 2023.1; this project keeps it working on current releases. Licensed under Apache-2.0.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Community port of the original Resin plugin, now supporting IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 - 2026.3.
  • Recompiled with JDK 17 and the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x.
  • Fixes version detection and configuration generation for newer Resin releases.
